_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Airworthiness Compliance Report
summary: Specifies content for the Airworthiness Compliance Report, which provides airworthiness certification criteria verification results used to approve the airworthiness assessment and support the airworthiness approval.
use_relationship:
The purpose of the Airworthiness Compliance Report is to provide airworthiness certification criteria verification results. The data will be used to approve the airworthiness assessment and to support the airworthiness approval.

a. This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format and content preparation for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement as delineated in the contract.

b. This DID shall be used in conjunction with DI-SESS-81766, Airworthiness Certification Basis. (Copies of this document are available online at https://quicksearch.dla.mil.)

c. This DID supersedes DI-SESS-81768.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference documents
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of the documents cited herein, including their approval dates and dates of any applicable amendments, notices, and revisions, shall be as specified in the contract.

preparation_instructions.title: Format
preparation_instructions.content: The EZZ Template 130-1 or Airworthiness Certification Tool data import template shall be used for the compliance report (Copies of the templates are available upon e-mail request to USAF.Airworthiness.Office@us.af.mil.). The system description and information that is not included in the template shall be in contractor format.

preparation_instructions.title: Content
preparation_instructions.content: The Airworthiness Compliance Report shall contain the following:

children.title: Data Identifiers
children.content: The Airworthiness Compliance Report shall contain information needed to maintain configuration control (e.g., date, revision, and managing office).

children.title: System Description
children.content: The Airworthiness Compliance Report shall include information to identify the system being assessed (e.g., mission design series (MDS), engine types and quantity, crew and passenger capabilities) in accordance with Airworthiness Bulletin (AWB)-110, "Airworthiness Planning". It shall also contain a list of previous certifications obtained, either civil or military. (Copies of the AWB are available upon e-mail request to USAF.Airworthiness.Office@us.af.mil.)

children.title: Compliance Report
children.content: The report shall list the airworthiness certification basis, including Criteria Number, Criterion, Standard, Method of Compliance per MIL-HDBK-516, Airworthiness Certification Criteria, data references, relevant system specification requirements.

children.title: Data references to support compliance
children.content: If data references to support compliance maps to a contractual requirement (e.g. SOO/SOW paragraph, CDRL), then the traceability shall be provided.

children.title: Airworthiness Compliance Report
children.content: The Airworthiness Compliance Report shall be prepared in accordance with Airworthiness Bulletin (AWB)-140, "Compliance Report". For commercial derivative aircraft, the compliance report shall be constructed in accordance with AWB-360, "Commercial Derivative Aircraft Airworthiness".

children.title: Assessment of each applicable criteria
children.content: The Airworthiness Compliance Report shall contain an assessment of each applicable criteria from the certification basis. Rationale shall be provided for each criterion as to compliance or non-compliance.

children.title: Elements of the Method of Compliance
children.content: All elements of the Method of Compliance shall be addressed. Each Method of Compliance shall be linked to specific substantiating data reference(s), to include document identifiers and titles that specifically support showing of compliance for the criterion. The Airworthiness Compliance Report shall also identify the location of any substantiating data and specific detailed references within (e.g. sections, pages, paragraphs).

children.title: Document summary
children.content: The Airworthiness Compliance Report shall contain a document summary that lists all substantiating data reference(s). The document summary shall include traceability to the appropriate section(s) it supports a show of compliance for and include the title, file name, document owner, and received or expected date. The EZZ Template 130-1 includes an example of this document summary listing report (Copies of the template are available upon e-mail request to USAF.Airworthiness.Office@us.af.mil.).

children.title: Non-compliant criteria
children.content: Non-compliant criteria shall include a hazard, hazard risk acceptance code IAW AWB-150 "AW Risk Assessment and Acceptance", and mitigation plan. Restrictions shall also be identified for non-compliant criteria as applicable.

children.title: Contact Information
children.content: The Airworthiness Compliance Report shall include the contractor's responsible engineer(s) listing: name, phone number, email. The listing may be in contractor format and shall provide points of contact for airworthiness certification criteria assessments. This information shall be separate from the compliance report matrix.

children.title: Classification Marking
children.content: Documents shall be marked in accordance with the applicable classification marking, as necessary, in accordance with DoD Manual (DoDM) 5200.01, Volume 2, DoD Information Security Program: Marking of Information, or Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI) markings (when applicable) in accordance with DoDI 5200.48, Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI). (Copies of these documents are available online at www.esd.whs.mil/DD.)
